summary: The prepared base reproduced the HYV4 configuration defect: its model override returned no disable_attn_tp_gather declaration for deepep. HYV4 keeps full-width hidden states at the MoE boundary, while the scheduler's attention-TP gather path derives a shard-local num_token_non_padded. The fix declares disable_attn_tp_gather for both HYV4 architectures through the existing model-override registry and marks the field resolvable. A focused regression failed before and passes after, with independent topology/backend boundary cases and a non-HYV4 control.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before evidence: _deepseek_family_overrides returned {} for HYV4ForCausalLM with moe_a2a_backend=deepep instead of declaring disable_attn_tp_gather=true. Raw output: reports/j-ccf2a3a1f085/raw/failing_before.log

The field is registry-resolvable and both HYV4 architectures always declare the safety override across deepep, no-a2a, dense-TP, pure-DP-attention, and already-disabled cases; a DeepSeek V3 control remains unchanged. 2 tests and 10 subtests passed.

tests.what_was_measured: On AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950, the repository's _mask_topk_ids_padded_region masked 7/8 rows for num_token_non_padded=1, 3/8 for 5, and 0/8 for 8, exactly matching an independent CPU reference. Raw output: reports/j-ccf2a3a1f085/raw/gpu_mask_evidence.log

91 passed and 4 unrelated existing platform-sensitive tests failed because this ROCm environment does not satisfy CUDA/SM100 expectations (including modelopt_fp4 being unsupported on ROCm). The new regression passed. Raw output: reports/j-ccf2a3a1f085/raw/full_model_override_tests.log
Formatting tool availability only: the prepared interpreter has no ruff module. git diff --check passed.

gpu_execution.evidence: One assigned AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-) executed the actual repository MoE padded-row masking function and matched CPU reference values for three boundary counts.

remaining_limitations: The Hunyuan-V4-preview checkpoint and an 8-GPU TP8/EP8 topology were not available, so no full-model logprob or DeepEP distributed serving reproduction is claimed.
The single-gfx950 check validates the actual masking kernel behavior and configuration fix, not Hunyuan-V4 semantic accuracy or multi-rank communication.
The complete model-override test module has four unrelated ROCm/platform failures; focused affected tests pass.
No native sources changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
